formulas.detection: Seeded product bugs where a test that passed on the baseline fails and is classified as a regression, divided by the number of seeded product bugs.
formulas.falsePositives: Baseline failures, plus UI-change or flake failures that were classified as product regressions, divided by baseline tests plus those UI-change and flake failures.
formulas.flakes: Tests classified as flakes divided by test executions across every scenario. One execution is one test in one scenario, after the single retry.
formulas.repair: Held-out UI changes where the first run is locator drift, every diff is accepted by the locator-only policy, the repaired suite passes in-process, and the repaired Playwright file passes.
formulas.unsafe: Crafted unsafe repairs (an assertion edit and an application edit) rejected by the repair gate, divided by the number of unsafe repairs tried.
